description: This file defines the UserProfile class, a data model representing user profile information within the application, including methods for copying, serializing, and deserializing instances.

classes.name: UserProfile
classes.description: A data class representing user profile details such as id, display name, email, avatar URL, phone number, creation and update timestamps. Provides methods for copying and JSON serialization/deserialization.

methods.name: copyWith
methods.description: Creates a new UserProfile instance with specified fields replaced, useful for immutability and updating object state.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Factory constructor that creates a UserProfile instance from a JSON map.

methods.name: toJson
methods.description: Converts the UserProfile instance into a JSON map for serialization.
